purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official municipal sources establish a local Cadastro Imobiliário and describe a digital map platform with quadras e lotes and property consultation. The current official page did not expose a viewer URL or JavaScript/API configuration. Candidate map-host requests were unavailable or unresolved. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
registryAssessment: Local municipal registry/map custody is evidenced by the Prefeitura de Montes Claros / SEFIN announcement and Decreto Municipal 4888/2024. The decree says the Cadastro Imobiliário records territorial parcels, buildings, improvements, titularity/possession/property and location, and identifies units by a numeric Índice Cadastral. This is local registry evidence; it does not establish public vector-service reuse.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official SEFIN page fetched HTTP 200. It describes a municipal GIS with quadras e lotes and citizen consultation of imóveis, lotes e edificações; no embedded viewer/API URL was present.
Official municipal decree fetched HTTP 200. It regulates the Cadastro Imobiliário and defines the numeric Índice Cadastral; no public geometry endpoint is linked.

Contractor project page describes historical SIG production for the municipality, including vectorized cadastral lots and cadastral-unit identifiers. It was used as contextual evidence only; no endpoint or raw parcel data was retained.

remainingUncertainty: The map platform may have a current viewer/API not indexed or not linked in the announcement. Its public access mode, layer schema, CRS, native ID, and exact-point parcel coverage require a later independent inspection. A timeout, host failure or missing endpoint is not evidence of citywide absence.
